newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux to distribute Granges shares.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux to distribute Granges shares.

text.p: Swedish appliance maker Electrolux AB said on Friday it plans to distribute all shares in its wholly-owned unit, aluminum profile maker Granges, to Electrolux shareholders.
Electrolux said the recycling operations of Granges would not be included in the distribution.
Granges is Europe's second largest producer of extruded aluminium profiles and thin foil. 1996 sales amounted to 10 billion crowns.
Electrolux said preliminary discussions with the Swedish tax board indicated Lex Asea regulations would be applicable in the Granges share sale.
"Distribution of the shares would thus not involve any immediate fiscal consequences for shareholders or for Electrolux," the company said.
More information on the sale would be made available on March 6, when Electrolux's consolidated results are published.
Separately, Granges said its 1996 operating profit fell sharply to 461 million crowns compared with 831 in the previous year. Turnover fell to 10.01 billion crowns from 11.45 billion.
